rooms.name: Cellar Stairs
rooms.description: The stairs down from the tavern go on far longer than the building is tall. A hand-painted sign reads: 'DUNGEON (NOT A DUNGEON, JUST A VERY SERIOUS CELLAR)'.

rooms.name: The Kegs
rooms.description: Hundreds of barrels, stacked to a ceiling that is somehow a hundred feet up. One of them is clearly watching you. A faded notice says: 'FARMING THIS AREA IS AGAINST THE RULES. - MGMT'.

rooms.name: The Pantry of Respawning Cheese
rooms.description: A single wheel of cheese sits on a shelf. You take it. Another wheel appears. You take that one too. This has clearly been going on a while. A goblin sits in the corner, keeping score.
